input: Order a custom name stamp for my stationery

gold.taskTitle: Order a custom name stamp for stationery
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to purchase a personalized name stamp to use on their stationery.

questions.title: What exact name or text should the stamp say?
questions.description: Identify the precise text to be engraved or etched on the stamp, such as a full name, initials, or a title.

questions.title: What size should the stamped impression be?
questions.description: Determine the physical dimensions of the stamp impression the user needs for their stationery.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred font style in mind?
questions.description: Find out if the user wants a specific typeface such as script, serif, sans-serif, or a decorative style.

questions.title: Should the stamp include any design elements beyond text?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants additional graphics, borders, monograms, or decorative flourishes on the stamp.

questions.title: What ink color do you want the stamp to produce?
questions.description: Determine the preferred ink color, such as black, navy, burgundy, or a custom color.

questions.title: Is there a specific vendor or website you want to use?
questions.description: Find out if the user already has a preferred supplier, such as Etsy, Zazzle, or a local print shop.

questions.title: What is your budget and deadline for receiving it?
questions.description: Establish the maximum the user is willing to spend and the date by which the stamp must arrive.
